saw_lines: Glasses are chosen with someone else’s opinion, then tried on, so the buyer wants a second opinion before paying.
So the sale is won or lost on the first screen, before a shopper compares the next optician.
Your 18 of 30 ads open on the same rentrée line, so build two new openers around the Miu Miu pair and a style question and test each against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 12 Oct 2026
points: 18 of 30 ads open on one line, “pour la rentrée, venez profiter”, so a shopper who skips it sees no second reason. Build two new openers around the Miu Miu pair and a style question, each tested against that line.

None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a buyer choosing frames has nothing concrete to weigh before clicking. Collect one real figure, like a review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.
All 30 ads started within the last 11 days, so none has run long enough to show what keeps working. Keep the oldest video and build three variations of it, each with a new first line and a new photo.
Your ads push a 60€ rentrée discount, but none speaks to a first time online buyer with a reason to act today. Add a first order offer, or a two frame bundle, to the first line of three new ads.

ads_1: Fresh openers built on your frames, tested against the rentrée line
